name: swarm-ui
description: Claude Code's own terminal as the Sonnet builds / Haiku swarms / advisor / Jev layout, with session-scoped model modes

escalation.title: Mode escalation
escalation.description: ask: before a prompt that looks like a harder task, offer a stronger mode in a dialog (it never switches on its own). off: never ask.

classifier.title: Haiku check when unsure
classifier.description: When the keyword rules are unsure, ask Haiku once to rate the prompt (at most 20 times a session).

motion.title: Animation
motion.description: auto follows Claude Code's own reduceMotion setting; reduced draws no movement; full always animates.
